subject: crossfit junkies
one_liner: Workout videos with a replay button for every rep and an opinion from everyone who skipped the session.
brand_voice_notes: Straight-faced observations about filming workouts, replaying disputed reps and watching more training videos than sets. Use video and gym actions that a new reader can understand.

hero.h1: Your last rep needs an audience.
hero.sub: Again turns CrossFit videos into rep-by-rep replays. The people who skipped your session would like to review your squat.

features.title: A chapter for every rep.
features.blurb: Jump straight to the rep everyone is talking about. Rep seven has a small but committed following.

features.title: Count it. Or start a thread.
features.blurb: Check the movement, mark whether the rep counts, and add a comment at that exact moment. Someone will watch it twelve more times and disagree.

features.title: One more set. Of videos.
features.blurb: Finish watching a workout and another queues up. You have now watched six sets during your two-minute rest.

demo_screen_concept: One video-review watch page for Twelve wall balls, one camera. A simulated 60-second review player has play/pause, seek and chapter selection. Twelve rep buttons jump to five-second chapters; nine initially accepted and reps 4, 8 and 12 outside frame. A judge panel changes the selected verdict between accepted and no rep, updating live counts and filtered chapter list. Subscription toggle and a local timestamped comment form complete the watch-page mechanics. Clearly labeled simulated review with no real video or API.

design_direction.style: Bright sports editorial: pool-blue open canvas, condensed italic cobalt headlines, restrained orange review cues, compact split opening and purposeful photographic workout/framing compositions.

palette.name: Pool Blue, Cobalt and Safety Orange

design_direction.archetype: Product-led split hero with recognizable video review preview, three feature observations, camera framing explanation, testimonials and plan comparison.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 160ms control color transitions. Playback moves the playhead only after user action. Reduced motion disables CSS transitions. No ambient loops.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: A compact split hero pairs the proposition with a recognizable workout-video preview and twelve clickable chapters. An athlete motion collage shows the exercise. A smaller two-camera comparison explains why framing affects the sample rep review; live HTML labels carry the meaning and counts. Logo stays in navigation and footer.
design_direction.design_review: Read latest seven concepts and identity records. Library recommends vibrant blocks, video-first and Space Grotesk. Retain video-first, replace dark pink default and recently used Space Grotesk with library Sports/Fitness pair and pool-blue equipment catalogue. No matching tuple. Strapped replay symbol and airbrushed sculptural equipment differ from huddle contours, selected seeds, parcel tabs, lightsticks, cinema programmes, timing lime and intern noticeboard. Boldness concentrated in campaign object and condensed hero. No numbered features or decorative eyebrow labels.

generation.revision_reason: User-requested correction of unclear campaign/infographic imagery after visual QA calibration. Retain the original Gemini logo; replace the two supporting artworks using the built-in image_gen tool with honest provenance.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: The original Gemini lifting-strap replay symbol and Again wordmark remain. Photographic wall-ball motion and camera-framing graphics now show the specific workout and review action, instead of turning the brand motif into an unexplained equipment object.

Exact wordmark text: "Again" with capital A, lowercase gain, no other text. A bespoke confident slightly forward-leaning condensed sans wordmark, clean readable lettering. Direction A: a thick woven lifting strap loops back around itself into a compact return/replay symbol with an open central gap; the strap should feel load-bearing, with a small orange folded end. Original silhouette, no play triangle, no YouTube mark, no rounded-square badge, no stock dumbbell. Symbol on left, Again on right, centered horizontal lockup with generous clear space. Flat cobalt #214DA6 and orange #F25536 ink on perfectly flat pale pool-blue #E5F1FA background. Flat vector-like actual production logo only, no mockup, no board, no texture, no gradients, no shadow, no extra text. Design for legibility at navigation scale and a clear 32px symbol.
